name: long-form-distribution
description: Turn a published newsletter issue or essay into social posts built from your own sentences, and track which ones went live on a local dashboard.

interface.longDescription: Give it a published newsletter issue or essay. It splits the piece into sections, writes LinkedIn, X and Substack Notes posts out of your own sentences, checks every post against the piece for invented facts and dropped caveats, and puts them on a local dashboard where you tick off what went live.
